# Asian Chip Supply Tightens, Prices Keep Rising  
**Bottom line:** Expect tighter lead times and higher pricing; lock in key MOSFETs now, but hold on less‑critical analog parts.

## What changed
- Market supply risk nudged up to **71.6** (+0.5) and price trend stays high at **82.2** (no change) [1][2].  
- TSMC foundry loading surged 56 % YoY through Oct 2026, pushing supply risk higher [3].  
- Book‑to‑bill ratio hit **1.05**, indicating orders outpacing shipments [4].  
- Electronics inventory cover fell 7 % below the 5‑yr average, shrinking buffers [5].

## Featured part: IPB017N10N5ATMA1
- Lead time **14 weeks**, stock **27,081** units, no on‑order quantity disclosed.  
- Price **$5.56** for qty‑1, **$2.51** for 1 k units.  
- Origin **Austria**, tariff **0 %** (no surcharge).  
- Buy‑timing call **“Hold course”** – 59 % chance prices rise, but timing signal weak [featured_part].

## Alerts
- **Call change:** ATSAMD21G18A‑AU moves from “Lock pricing (no need to buy ahead)” to **Hold course** – 60 % chance of price rise; market 46 % above target, so negotiate rather than wait [alerts].

## Segment board
- Processors & advanced logic – **Elevated** (71.7, +0.6), **Rising** (79.6), High confidence.  
- Memory (DRAM/NAND/HBM) – **Rising** (69.9, +0.1), **Rising** (74.0), High confidence.  
- Analog & power management – **Rising** (69.2, +0.2), **Rising** (76.7), High confidence.  
- Microcontrollers & embedded – **Rising** (66.8, +0.3), **Rising** (76.4), High confidence.  
- Power discretes – **Rising** (66.2, +0.1), **Rising** (79.8), High confidence.

## Your BOM watchlist
- **10M08SAE144C8G** – Severe supply risk 86.1, 52‑week lead time vs 12‑week norm.  
- **SN65HVD230DR** – Elevated risk 82.3, 26‑week lead time.  
- **LM358DR** – Elevated risk 82.1, 26‑week lead time.  
- **TPS62130RGTR** – Elevated risk 81.7, 26‑week lead time.  
- **TLV9002IDR** – Elevated risk 81.3, 26‑week lead time.

## Outlook
- **Chip prices, next 3 mo:** 66 % chance of rise, expected **+2.17 %** (range ‑9.57 % to +13.91 %); model‑tested edge.  
- **Chip prices, next 6 mo:** 52 % chance of rise, expected **+4.34 %** (range ‑8.79 % to +17.46 %); trend‑following baseline.  
- **Fab utilization, next 3 mo:** 63 % chance supply tightens, expected **+1.82 pts** (range ‑1.71 to +5.36 pts); baseline.  
- **Fab utilization, next 6 mo:** 60 % chance supply tightens, expected **+3.64 pts** (range ‑2.16 to +9.45 pts); baseline.  
- Buy‑ahead list includes the high‑risk MOSFET **IPB017N10N5ATMA1** and several analog parts; hold course on the ATSAMD21G18A‑AU.

## Negotiation angle
1. **Lock pricing on high‑risk MOSFETs** (e.g., IPB017N10N5ATMA1) now to avoid the 14‑week lead‑time exposure and potential 59 % price‑rise probability.  
2. **Push for volume discounts** on the 1 k price tier ($2.51) while citing the 46 % market premium on the ATSAMD21G18A‑AU to secure better terms.  
3. **Ask suppliers to share on‑order visibility** for the 26‑week lead‑time analog parts; use the severe lead‑time deviation (52 weeks vs 12) as leverage for expedited shipments or alternative sourcing.
